dossier_meta.catalog_title: Near-sunflower analogue of the Erdős-Rado Sunflower Conjecture
dossier_meta.statement_text: If $\mathcal{F}$ is a $k$-uniform family of sets containing no near-sunflower of size $r$, then $|\mathcal{F}| \leq C^k$, where $C$ is a constant depending only on $r$.
dossier_meta.context_text: The paper introduces near-sunflowers as a weakening of sunflowers (allowing elements to belong to $0, 1, r-1,$ or $r$ sets in the family) and proposes this bound as a weaker version of the notorious Erdős-Rado sunflower conjecture. While the paper resolves the Erdős-Szemerédi-type question (exponential bound in $n$) for near-sunflowers via Theorem 1.3, the Erdős-Rado-type question (exponential bound in $k$) is explicitly left open; Section 6 proves the bound only under a stronger condition.
